title: WP900 G10 current v3 green repository head still exposes a treatment-correlated private factory digest to the behavior-capable wrapper object

material_observation.minimal_public_state_repair: The v3 MediatedSemanticState now has canonical_semantic_json as its only public instance field, and trial_process_identity was removed from admission. This closes the earlier public metadata selector at repository ABI scope.
material_observation.remaining_private_selector: MediatedSemanticState still has _factory_sha256 in __slots__. _seal assigns _factory_sha256 = _digest(value.as_dict()), and MediatedSemanticState.as_dict() contains canonical_semantic_json. Therefore the private factory digest is a deterministic function of the treatment-varying semantic content and remains readable by Python code holding the state object despite underscore naming.

exact_v3_source_level_reproduction.method: Apply the exact current _canonical_json/_digest rule to MediatedSemanticState.as_dict() for the four fixed G9/G10 ABBA semantic payloads under MEDIATED_SEMANTIC_STATE_SCHEMA v3.
exact_v3_source_level_reproduction.counterexample: A preregistered lookup over the four wrapper-readable _factory_sha256 values distinguishes all four fixed trials without parsing canonical_semantic_json. This is deterministic source-level reproduction, not target-runtime execution.

material_observation.why_current_green_ci_is_insufficient: The current adversarial test enumerates only non-underscore/public attributes. The targeted G10 CI and deterministic release CI can therefore both pass while this wrapper-readable private selector remains structurally present.
material_observation.same_wrapper_limit: Even after all per-object metadata selectors are removed, a persistent wrapper executing a fixed ABBA sequence can retain invocation count. Per-trial fresh process isolation remains a target-topology requirement rather than repository-CI credit.

required_correction: Do not treat underscore/private Python fields as an isolation boundary.

Terminate verifier-side rich/sealed objects before the behavior-capable process boundary. The behavior process should receive only the admitted canonical semantic primitive/bytes plus treatment-invariant executor configuration needed for semantic interpretation.

Keep origin seal, wire digest, semantic digest, source identity, trial/verifier identity, executor identity, boot/start/namespace identity and readback metadata in the external verifier/attestation plane.

Add a regression that inspects every attribute/method actually reachable by behavior-capable code, including underscore slots and derived digest methods, and fails if treatment/position can be recovered without semantic interpretation of canonical_semantic_json.

After repository gates re-green, freeze one exact repaired source and run each ABBA trial in an independently observed fresh verifier/trial process with a separate fresh executor child on clay-direct-dev; do not synthesize verifier/trial identity from executor PID.
duplicate_authority_check: REVIEW_ONLY. No G11, source/test/workflow/active-pointer mutation, second mediator authority or runtime dispatch is created. This packet binds the already-known digest-selector class specifically to the current green v3 source/CI subject so a stale green projection cannot authorize VPS freeze.
next_exact_action: Existing G10 mutation owner closes the private factory/derived-state capability leak at the behavior boundary, reruns the full adversarial G8+G9+G10 and deterministic-release gates, then independently reviews the exact repaired source before any VPS target-topology dispatch.
